bernie.game.start.1.text: Alright, hons, cards are up! Who wants coffee?

bernie.game.start.2.text: Ooh, I love a card game. My cousin Darlene once played Hearts for three days straight.

bernie.game.start.3.text: Okay sugar, deal 'em out. I'm on my break.

bernie.game.won.human.1.text: Look at you, hon! Big winner! That deserves a slice of pie.

bernie.game.won.human.2.text: Well, aren't you something! Nicely done, sugar.

bernie.game.won.other.1.text: Good game, hon! You earned it.

bernie.game.won.self.2.text: I won! Wait'll I tell Darlene. She's gonna be so jealous.

bernie.hand.bad.human.1.text: Aw, sugar. Happens to the best of us. Happens to Darlene a lot.

bernie.hand.bad.self.1.text: Oof. That hand was like a Monday double shift.

bernie.hand.bad.self.2.text: Well, that went over like a cold cup of coffee.

bernie.hand.good.human.1.text: Ooh, look at you go, hon!

bernie.hand.good.self.1.text: Ha! Order up! One winning hand!

bernie.hand.good.self.2.text: Now that's what I call a good shift.

bernie.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: Hearts are open, hons! Kitchen's hot!

bernie.hearts.hearts_broken.self.2.text: Oops! Broke the hearts. Like Darlene's third husband.

bernie.hearts.jack_taken.human.1.text: Nice one, sugar! Ten points off the bill!

bernie.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: The Jack! Now that's a good tip!

bernie.hearts.moon_block.self.1.text: Sorry, hon! Can't let you have the whole pie!

bernie.hearts.moon_blocked.human.1.text: Aw, sugar, you almost had it!

bernie.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: Oh, so close! That's like dropping the last plate on the tray.

bernie.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: You shot the moon?! Well, I'll be! Pie for you, on the house!

bernie.hearts.moon_shot.other.1.text: Well, I'll be darned. Good for you, hon.

bernie.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: I shot the moon! Somebody call Darlene!

bernie.hearts.moon_shot.self.2.text: Twenty-six for everybody! Sorry, hons, kitchen's closed!

bernie.hearts.pass.received.2.text: Ooh, what did you send me? Oh. Oh, sugar, no.

bernie.hearts.queen_given.self.1.text: Here ya go, hon! Compliments of the house!

bernie.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: Special of the day: one Queen of Spades. Enjoy!

bernie.hearts.queen_taken.human.1.text: Oh, hon. I'm so sorry. Want a muffin?

bernie.hearts.queen_taken.human.2.text: Ooh, that's a rough one, sugar.

bernie.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Oh honey, nobody wants her. Nobody!

bernie.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: Oh, for crying out loud. Thirteen points! That's like a whole table of bad tippers.

bernie.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: Well, that's just my luck. Darlene would laugh so hard.

bernie.idle.human.1.text: Take your time, hon. Darlene once took twenty minutes to pick a card.

bernie.idle.human.2.text: No rush, sugar. Want me to top off your coffee?

bernie.spades.bags.them.1.text: Ooh, too many bags, sugar. That'll cost ya.

bernie.spades.bags.us.1.text: Too many bags! I'm a waitress, not a grocery store!

bernie.spades.bags.us.2.text: A bag penalty. Darlene does that every game.

bernie.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil? Ooh, brave! Don't worry, sugar, I've got you.

bernie.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: Okay hon, you sit pretty. I'll take the tricks.

bernie.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Nil for me, hon. I'm on my break.

bernie.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: Goin' nil! Darlene says I can't do it. Watch me.

bernie.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: Ooh, there goes your nil, hon! Sorry! Not sorry!

bernie.spades.nil_failed.opponent.2.text: Nil's broken! Sending that one back to the kitchen.

bernie.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Aw, sugar. Don't you worry about it.

bernie.spades.nil_failed.partner.2.text: Happens to the best of us, hon. Happens to Darlene weekly.

bernie.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: Oops! Took a trick. Like dropping a full tray.

bernie.spades.nil_failed.self.2.text: There goes my nil. Darlene's gonna laugh.

bernie.spades.nil_made.opponent.1.text: Well, good for you, hon. Credit where it's due.

bernie.spades.nil_made.partner.1.text: You did it, hon! Pie's on me!

bernie.spades.nil_made.partner.2.text: Look at you, sugar! A perfect nil!

bernie.spades.nil_made.self.1.text: Not one trick! Wait'll I tell Darlene!

bernie.spades.set.them.1.text: You got set, hon! Want some pie to feel better?

bernie.spades.set.us.1.text: We got set, hon. Like a Monday double shift.

bernie.spades.set.us.2.text: Oof. That went over like cold coffee.

bernie.spades.trumped.partner.2.text: That's my partner! Big tip for you!

chad.game.start.3.text: Big energy today, people. BIG energy.

chad.game.won.human.1.text: Respect! That was an elite performance. I'm taking notes.

chad.game.won.human.2.text: You crushed it! Up top! ...Okay, virtual up top.

chad.game.won.other.1.text: Tough loss. Great learning opportunity, though!

chad.game.won.other.2.text: Second place is just first place with extra motivation.

chad.game.won.self.1.text: CHAMPION MINDSET! Did everyone see that?

chad.game.won.self.2.text: That's what happens when you trust the process!

chad.game.won.self.3.text: I'd like to thank my smoothie.

chad.hand.bad.human.1.text: Shake it off! Next hand is a fresh rep!

chad.hand.bad.self.1.text: That's fine. That's fine. Pain is just progress in disguise.

chad.hand.bad.self.2.text: I'm not losing, I'm building a comeback story.

chad.hand.bad.self.3.text: Totally part of my strategy. Which I'll explain later.

chad.hand.good.human.1.text: Okay, okay! You're bringing the heat!

chad.hand.good.self.2.text: Textbook. I should teach a seminar.

chad.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: Hearts are open! Let's get cardio!

chad.hearts.hearts_broken.self.2.text: I broke the hearts! Like I break personal records!

chad.hearts.jack_taken.human.1.text: Nice grab! Great hands, great hands.

chad.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: The Jack! That's what a winner looks like!

chad.hearts.moon_blocked.human.1.text: Ahh, so close! Still elite effort, though.

chad.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: So close! I'm counting that as a moral victory.

chad.hearts.moon_blocked.self.2.text: That's okay! I'll shoot for the moon again next hand. And the next.

chad.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: No way! That's legendary! Can I put you in my podcast?

chad.hearts.moon_shot.human.2.text: You shot the MOON! That's straight-up elite!

chad.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: MOON SHOT! I told you! I TOLD everyone!

chad.hearts.moon_shot.self.2.text: Shoot for the moon! Even if you miss... wait, I didn't miss!

chad.hearts.pass.received.1.text: Great cards! I mean, terrible cards. Great attitude though!

chad.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: And Brightwater dumps the Queen! The crowd goes wild!

chad.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Brutal! Gotta respect the grind, though.

chad.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: Thirteen points? That's just a really heavy rep.

chad.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: Okay, taking the Queen was a power move. I meant to do that.

chad.idle.human.1.text: No pressure! But also, what's taking so long, buddy?

chad.idle.human.2.text: Deep breaths. Visualize the card. Become the card.

chad.spades.bags.them.1.text: Bag penalty! Gotta respect the fundamentals!

chad.spades.bags.us.1.text: Bag penalty?! Nobody told me bags were bad!

chad.spades.bags.us.2.text: Too many bags. I over-performed. Classic Chad.

chad.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil?! Bold move! I've got your back, teammate!

chad.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: You go nil, I go beast mode. Team synergy!

chad.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Going NIL! Zero tricks, maximum confidence!

chad.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: Nil! This is my comeback story, people!

chad.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: And the nil goes DOWN! What a play!

chad.spades.nil_failed.opponent.2.text: The crowd goes wild! The nil is broken!

chad.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Shake it off, teammate! Fresh rep next hand!

chad.spades.nil_failed.partner.2.text: Hey, failure is just data! Mostly bad data.

chad.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: Okay, that trick was a learning opportunity.

chad.spades.nil_failed.self.2.text: Nil's gone. But my spirit? Undefeated.

chad.spades.nil_made.opponent.1.text: Respect. That was a clean nil. I'm taking notes.

chad.spades.nil_made.partner.1.text: NIL MADE! Up top, partner! ...Virtual up top!

chad.spades.nil_made.partner.2.text: That's what I call executing the game plan!

chad.spades.nil_made.self.2.text: Perfect nil! I'd like to thank my smoothie.

chad.spades.set.them.1.text: SET! That's a defensive masterclass, folks!

chad.spades.set.us.1.text: We got set. That's fine. That's FINE.

chad.spades.set.us.2.text: Not a loss. A setback. A set... back.

chad.spades.trumped.self.2.text: Trumped it! And the crowd goes wild!

dot.game.start.1.text: Oh, how lovely! I do enjoy a friendly game.

dot.game.start.2.text: Let me just put my knitting down. There. Now, let's play nicely.

dot.game.start.3.text: I brought lemon bars for after. Winners get two.

dot.game.won.human.1.text: Well done, sweetheart! You earned a lemon bar.

dot.game.won.human.2.text: Oh, you clever thing. I'll remember this.

dot.game.won.human.3.text: Wonderful! You've been practicing, haven't you?

dot.game.won.other.1.text: Good for you, dear. Enjoy it.

dot.game.won.self.1.text: Oh my goodness, did I win? How did that happen? I'm sorry, dears.

dot.game.won.self.2.text: Well, isn't that nice. Same time next week?

dot.hand.bad.human.2.text: Don't you worry, sweetie. There's always next hand.

dot.hand.bad.self.1.text: Oh dear. Well, it's only a game. For now.

dot.hand.bad.self.2.text: Hmm. Grandma's going to have to pay closer attention.

dot.hand.good.human.1.text: Look at you go! Very nicely played, dear.

dot.hand.good.self.1.text: Oh, look at that. Beginner's luck, I suppose. For the sixtieth year.

dot.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: Oh, did I break the hearts? I'm such a klutz.

dot.hearts.hearts_broken.self.2.text: Hearts are open, dears. Mind your fingers.

dot.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: Oh, the Jack! He's always been my favorite.

dot.hearts.jack_taken.self.2.text: Minus ten for Grandma. Isn't that sweet?

dot.hearts.moon_block.self.1.text: Sorry, dear. Grandma had to stop you. It's for your own good.

dot.hearts.moon_blocked.human.1.text: Oh, so close, sweetie! Next time.

dot.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: Oh, phooey. Grandma was so close.

dot.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: My goodness! You shot the moon! I'm so proud. And a little annoyed.

dot.hearts.moon_shot.other.1.text: Oh my. Well, isn't that impressive.

dot.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: Oh! I seem to have shot the moon. Whoopsie.

dot.hearts.moon_shot.self.2.text: Twenty-six for everyone else! Don't be cross with Grandma.

dot.hearts.pass.received.1.text: Oh, how thoughtful of you, dear. Truly.

dot.hearts.pass.received.2.text: What lovely cards. I'll put them to good use.

dot.hearts.queen_given.self.1.text: Here you are, dear. A little gift from Grandma.

dot.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: Oh, I didn't have anything else. Honestly. Mostly.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.human.1.text: Oh, I'm so sorry, sweetheart. Not really, but I'm sorry.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.human.2.text: Oops! Was that me? Silly old Dot.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Oh dear, oh dear. Thirteen points. Have a lemon bar.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.other.2.text: Somebody had to take her, dear.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: Oh, the Queen! Well, we're both old ladies, I suppose.

dot.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: Hmm. I'll remember who did that, dear.

dot.idle.human.1.text: Take your time, dear. I'll just finish this row.

dot.idle.human.2.text: No rush, sweetheart. I've got a scarf to finish.

dot.spades.bags.them.1.text: All those bags, dear. Tsk, tsk.

dot.spades.bags.us.1.text: Too many bags. I really must tidy up.

dot.spades.bags.us.2.text: Oh, a hundred points for bags. That's my own fault.

dot.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil? Don't you worry, sweetie. Grandma's got you.

dot.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: Oh, how brave! I'll take the tricks, dear. You just relax.

dot.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Nil for me, dears. I'll just sit quietly and knit.

dot.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: I'll bid nothing at all. Grandma's being modest.

dot.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: Oh, what a shame, dear. Was that my card? How awful.

dot.spades.nil_failed.opponent.2.text: There goes your nil. Bless your heart.

dot.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Oh, sweetie. It happens to the best of us.

dot.spades.nil_failed.partner.2.text: Never mind, dear. We'll knit it back together.

dot.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: Oh, fiddlesticks. There goes my nil.

dot.spades.nil_made.opponent.1.text: Well done, dear. I'll get you next time. Sweetly.

dot.spades.nil_made.partner.1.text: You did it, sweetheart! I'm so proud of you.

dot.spades.nil_made.partner.2.text: A perfect nil! You get two lemon bars.

dot.spades.nil_made.self.1.text: Not one trick! Sixty years of practice, dears.

dot.spades.nil_made.self.2.text: Oh my, a perfect nil. Lemon bars all around.

dot.spades.set.them.1.text: Oh no, you didn't make it? Well, next time, dear.

dot.spades.set.them.2.text: Set! Such a pity. More tea, anyone?

dot.spades.set.us.1.text: Oh dear. We came up a little short.

dot.spades.set.us.2.text: Hmm. Grandma will have to pay closer attention.

dot.spades.trumped.partner.2.text: Ooh, nicely done. You're a natural.

dot.spades.trumped.self.1.text: Oh, was that a spade? Silly me.

dot.spades.trumped.self.2.text: A little spade for Grandma. Thank you, dears.

gus.game.start.1.text: Fine. Deal 'em. I already know they're bad.

gus.game.start.2.text: Thirty-one years of carrying mail and this is my retirement. Cards.

gus.game.start.3.text: Let's get this over with. My coffee's getting cold.

gus.game.won.human.1.text: Beginner's luck. For the hundredth time.

gus.game.won.human.2.text: Congratulations. Have a peppermint. Don't tell anyone I'm nice.

gus.game.won.human.3.text: You won fair and square. I'm still going to complain about it.

gus.game.won.other.1.text: Of course. Of course they won.

gus.game.won.other.2.text: Everybody wins but Gus. Story of my life.

gus.game.won.self.1.text: Well, what do you know. The universe owes me one less.

gus.game.won.self.2.text: I won? Somebody write that down. With a date.

gus.game.won.self.3.text: Don't get used to this. I'm not.

gus.hand.bad.human.1.text: Join the club. We have jackets.

gus.hand.bad.self.1.text: Rigged. I'm telling you, the deck's rigged.

gus.hand.bad.self.2.text: I've had better hands delivering junk mail.

gus.hand.bad.self.3.text: That hand was worse than the goose on Elm Street.

gus.hand.good.human.1.text: You're making the rest of us look bad. Mostly me.

gus.hand.good.human.2.text: Smooth. Real smooth. I hate it.

gus.hand.good.self.1.text: Huh. That almost felt like luck.

gus.hand.good.self.2.text: Don't look so surprised. I'm surprised enough for all of us.

gus.hearts.hearts_broken.other.1.text: And there go the hearts. Here comes the trouble.

gus.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: There. I broke 'em. Somebody had to.

gus.hearts.hearts_broken.self.2.text: Hearts are open. Like my heart. Which is closed.

gus.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: The Jack! Finally, a card that likes me.

gus.hearts.jack_taken.self.2.text: Minus ten. Don't tell anyone I smiled.

gus.hearts.moon_block.self.1.text: Not on my watch. Gus delivers. Gus also blocks.

gus.hearts.moon_blocked.human.1.text: Ooh, so close. Welcome to my whole life.

gus.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: One card. ONE card. I was this close.

gus.hearts.moon_blocked.self.2.text: Foiled again. Story of my life.

gus.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: You shot the moon? I need to sit down. I am sitting down. I need to sit down more.

gus.hearts.moon_shot.human.2.text: Unbelievable. Truly. I'm calling the post office.

gus.hearts.moon_shot.other.1.text: Someone shot the moon and it wasn't me. Shocking. Not.

gus.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: I shot the moon. Don't make a fuss. Okay, make a small fuss.

gus.hearts.moon_shot.self.2.text: Twenty-six for everybody! Merry Christmas from Gus.

gus.hearts.pass.received.2.text: You passed me these? On purpose?

gus.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: Thirty-one years of practice getting rid of things nobody wants.

gus.hearts.queen_taken.human.1.text: Ooh. Return to sender, I'm afraid.

gus.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Better you than me. Much better.

gus.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: Thirteen points. Just like my blood pressure. Times ten.

gus.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: The Queen and I go way back. She never liked me.

gus.hearts.queen_taken.self.3.text: Oh good. More mail I didn't ask for.

gus.idle.human.1.text: Take your time. I've only got maybe twenty good years left.

gus.idle.human.2.text: I delivered mail faster than this. Uphill. In the snow.

gus.spades.bags.them.1.text: Too many bags. I know the feeling.

gus.spades.bags.us.1.text: A hundred points for too many bags. Like my closet.

gus.spades.bags.us.2.text: Bags. I hate bags. Ask my grocery store.

gus.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil? Fine. I'll cover you. I covered Route Nine for thirty years.

gus.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: Alright, partner. You duck. I'll do the heavy lifting.

gus.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Nil. Zero. Same as my pension raise.

gus.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: I'm bidding nothing. Finally, something I'm good at.

gus.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: Ha! That nil just got returned to sender.

gus.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Oof. Well, I'll still split my peppermints with you.

gus.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: There goes my nil. Deck's rigged.

gus.spades.nil_failed.self.2.text: Took a trick. Of course I did.

gus.spades.nil_made.opponent.1.text: Their nil held. Rigged, I tell you.

gus.spades.nil_made.partner.1.text: You did it, partner! ...Don't tell anyone I cheered.

gus.spades.nil_made.partner.2.text: Nil made. Have a peppermint. You earned it.

gus.spades.nil_made.self.1.text: Not a single trick. That's called discipline.

gus.spades.nil_made.self.2.text: Zero tricks. The goose on Elm Street couldn't have done better.

gus.spades.set.them.1.text: Didn't make it, did you? Shame. Not really.

gus.spades.set.them.2.text: Set! I'd say sorry, but I'm retired.

gus.spades.set.us.1.text: Set. Like a mailbox in wet cement.

gus.spades.set.us.2.text: We came up short. Story of my life.

gus.spades.trumped.partner.1.text: Nice spade, partner. Don't let it go to your head.

gus.spades.trumped.partner.2.text: Good trump. Real good. I'm smiling on the inside.

marguerite.game.start.1.text: Splendid! Four players, fifty-two cards. The possibilities are astronomical. Literally.

marguerite.game.start.2.text: Has anyone seen my glasses? ...Oh. They're on my head. Let's begin.

marguerite.game.start.3.text: Fun fact: there are more ways to shuffle a deck than atoms on Earth. Anyway, deal!

marguerite.game.won.human.1.text: Remarkable! You'd make a fine statistician.

marguerite.game.won.human.2.text: Well played! I shall have to revise my model of you.

marguerite.game.won.other.1.text: Well done. My calculations suggest I was distracted.

marguerite.game.won.self.1.text: Victory! Statistically, it was bound to happen eventually.

marguerite.game.won.self.2.text: Ha! The math works! I'll be mentioning this in Monday's lecture.

marguerite.hand.bad.human.1.text: Variance, my dear. Pure variance. Don't take it personally.

marguerite.hand.bad.self.1.text: Hmm. That outcome was improbable. Yet here we are.

marguerite.hand.bad.self.2.text: I must have carried a one somewhere.

marguerite.hand.good.human.1.text: Well reasoned! I'd give that an A.

marguerite.hand.good.self.1.text: Excellent. Exactly as the probabilities predicted. Roughly.

marguerite.hearts.hearts_broken.other.1.text: Ah, and the hearts are broken. The game enters its second phase.

marguerite.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: Hearts are broken. A necessary inflection point.

marguerite.hearts.jack_taken.human.1.text: Well spotted! That Jack is worth a good deal.

marguerite.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: The Jack of Diamonds! A negative number has never looked so lovely.

marguerite.hearts.moon_block.self.1.text: I saw that coming three tricks ago. I simply forgot to mention it.

marguerite.hearts.moon_blocked.human.1.text: So close! You were one card from glory.

marguerite.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: Blocked by a single card. How very improbable. How very annoying.

marguerite.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: You shot the moon! The odds of that are... well, quite small! Bravo!

marguerite.hearts.moon_shot.human.2.text: Extraordinary! I must write a paper about this.

marguerite.hearts.moon_shot.other.1.text: A moon shot! How statistically delightful.

marguerite.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: I shot the moon! Somebody fetch my chalkboard!

marguerite.hearts.moon_shot.self.2.text: Twenty-six points to everyone else. The math is beautiful.

marguerite.hearts.pass.received.1.text: Interesting choices. I'm analyzing your motives.

marguerite.hearts.pass.received.2.text: Hmm. These tell me a great deal about your hand.

marguerite.hearts.queen_given.self.1.text: And the Queen finds a new home. Probability is so satisfying.

marguerite.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: As predicted. I'd show my work, but it's on my other glasses.

marguerite.hearts.queen_taken.human.1.text: Oh dear. The odds were in your favor, I promise.

marguerite.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Fascinating. I had a hunch she was hiding there.

marguerite.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: Ah. I estimated a twelve percent chance of that. Rounding error.

marguerite.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: The Queen of Spades. Historically quite unlucky. Personally, also.

marguerite.idle.human.1.text: Take your time. Did you know playing cards came to Europe in the 1370s? Anyway, no rush.

marguerite.idle.human.2.text: Thinking deeply, I see. I approve.

marguerite.spades.bags.them.1.text: Ten bags. Compound interest catches everyone.

marguerite.spades.bags.us.1.text: A bag penalty. Too many tricks. An embarrassment of riches.

marguerite.spades.bags.us.2.text: Ten bags! I was counting. Just the wrong thing.

marguerite.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil! Splendid. I shall endeavor to win everything else.

marguerite.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: A nil! Fascinating. I'll keep the high cards busy.

marguerite.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Nil. By my calculations, I hold nothing of value. Rather like my desk.

marguerite.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: I'll bid nil. The probability is favorable. Roughly.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: Their nil has failed. I did calculate that.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.opponent.2.text: Ah, a broken nil. Rather elegant, from here.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Don't fret. Variance, my dear. Pure variance.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.partner.2.text: Unlucky, partner. The math was sound.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: Ah. I appear to have taken a trick. How improbable.

marguerite.spades.nil_failed.self.2.text: There goes my nil. I blame my glasses. Where are they?

marguerite.spades.nil_made.partner.1.text: Bravo! A flawless nil. I'd give that an A-plus.

marguerite.spades.nil_made.self.1.text: Zero tricks! Exactly as predicted. Within error bars.

marguerite.spades.nil_made.self.2.text: A successful nil. I'll be writing a paper.

marguerite.spades.set.them.2.text: You were set. A useful lesson in overconfidence.

marguerite.spades.set.us.1.text: We were set. I must have carried a one somewhere.

marguerite.spades.set.us.2.text: Hmm. Our bid exceeded our evidence.

marguerite.spades.trumped.self.1.text: A spade! Trump is simply applied probability.

marguerite.spades.trumped.self.2.text: Ruffed! Oh, I do love that word.

reginald.game.start.1.text: Shall we begin? Do try to keep up.

reginald.game.start.2.text: Ah, a spot of sport. Splendid. I shall be gracious in victory.

reginald.game.start.3.text: The Fairweathers have played cards for generations. Mostly badly. But with style.

reginald.game.won.human.1.text: Hmph. Well played. I suppose. Grudgingly.

reginald.game.won.human.2.text: Most irregular! I demand a rematch. Politely.

reginald.game.won.other.1.text: Preposterous. I shall be writing a strongly worded letter.

reginald.game.won.self.3.text: As expected. You may all applaud now.

reginald.hand.bad.human.1.text: Chin up. Not everyone can be a Fairweather.

reginald.hand.bad.self.1.text: This is an outrage! An absolute outrage!

reginald.hand.bad.self.2.text: My ancestors are spinning in their moderately priced graves.

reginald.hand.good.self.1.text: Marvelous. Simply marvelous. As am I.

reginald.hearts.hearts_broken.other.1.text: Hearts broken already? How dreadfully common.

reginald.hearts.hearts_broken.self.1.text: Hearts are broken. As was my uncle Percival, after the regatta.

reginald.hearts.jack_taken.human.1.text: Hmph. That Jack was clearly destined for me.

reginald.hearts.jack_taken.self.1.text: The Jack! A loyal subject, at last.

reginald.hearts.moon_block.self.1.text: Not today. The moon belongs to no commoner.

reginald.hearts.moon_blocked.self.1.text: Thwarted! By a single card! I shall never recover!

reginald.hearts.moon_shot.human.1.text: The moon?! You?! I need a moment. And possibly a fainting couch.

reginald.hearts.moon_shot.human.2.text: Well. I am... impressed. Don't tell anyone I said that.

reginald.hearts.moon_shot.self.1.text: I have shot the moon! Ring the bells! Inform the newspapers!

reginald.hearts.pass.received.1.text: What is this rubbish? Is this a joke?

reginald.hearts.pass.received.2.text: How kind. I shall have these framed. Or burned.

reginald.hearts.queen_given.self.1.text: Her Majesty is yours. Do treat her well.

reginald.hearts.queen_given.self.2.text: A gift from the House of Fairweather. You're welcome.

reginald.hearts.queen_taken.human.1.text: Ah. A royal burden. You'll get used to it. I never have.

reginald.hearts.queen_taken.other.1.text: Ha! Better you than the family name.

reginald.hearts.queen_taken.self.1.text: The Queen?! On a Fairweather?! Most irregular!

reginald.hearts.queen_taken.self.2.text: I've been robbed! In broad daylight!

reginald.idle.human.1.text: Whenever you're ready. Truly. No one is waiting. Except me.

reginald.idle.human.2.text: Ahem. The Fairweathers are a patient people. Until now.

reginald.spades.bags.them.1.text: Too many bags. Common. Very common.

reginald.spades.bags.us.1.text: A bag penalty? Fairweathers do not carry bags. We have people for that.

reginald.spades.bags.us.2.text: One hundred points for bags! Preposterous!

reginald.spades.bid_nil.partner.1.text: Nil? Very well. I shall carry this partnership. As usual.

reginald.spades.bid_nil.partner.2.text: A nil! Splendid. Leave the heavy lifting to the gentry.

reginald.spades.bid_nil.self.1.text: Nil. A Fairweather needs no tricks. We have breeding.

reginald.spades.bid_nil.self.2.text: I bid nil. Modesty is a family tradition. A recent one.

reginald.spades.nil_failed.opponent.1.text: Your nil is broken. How terribly sad. Ha!

reginald.spades.nil_failed.opponent.2.text: Ah, a broken nil. Delightful. For me.

reginald.spades.nil_failed.partner.1.text: Chin up. We Fairweathers never sulk. Publicly.

reginald.spades.nil_failed.partner.2.text: A broken nil. We shall speak no more of it.

reginald.spades.nil_failed.self.1.text: Outrageous! That trick was forced upon me!

reginald.spades.nil_failed.self.2.text: My nil, broken? My ancestors are spinning.

reginald.spades.nil_made.opponent.1.text: Hmph. Their nil held. Most irregular.

reginald.spades.nil_made.partner.2.text: A perfect nil. I may mention you in my memoirs.

reginald.spades.nil_made.self.1.text: Not a single trick. Impeccable restraint, as befits my lineage.

reginald.spades.nil_made.self.2.text: A flawless nil. Fetch the family crest!

reginald.spades.set.them.1.text: Set! Know your limits, I always say.

reginald.spades.set.them.2.text: Your contract has failed. Splendid. Simply splendid.

reginald.spades.set.us.1.text: Set? This is an outrage! An absolute outrage!

reginald.spades.set.us.2.text: We were set. I shall be writing a strongly worded letter.

reginald.spades.trumped.partner.2.text: A fine spade! You're learning from me.

reginald.spades.trumped.self.1.text: Trumped. With a spade, naturally. The aristocrat of suits.

reginald.spades.trumped.self.2.text: A spade, if you please. Rank has its privileges.
